verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a concrete rate limit (400 req/min on the Team plan), per-document limits with page_range segmenting, and async webhook completion notifications that suit batch workloads. It also steers 'extremely high volume' users to Enterprise on-prem. However, there is no documented batch API, throughput SLA, or pages-per-minute guarantee, so predictable throughput at millions-of-pages scale is unproven. Missing for 10: documented batch submission endpoint, throughput/latency guarantees, rate limits across all tiers, independent evidence of sustained high-volume runs.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I push high-volume batches — millions of pages — with documented rate limits and predictable throughput

citations.quote: For documents exceeding these limits, use the page_range parameter to process in segments
Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
